banking.description: A bank: branches, clients, accounts in different currencies, transactions and loans.

tables.accounts: Client accounts (closed_at = NULL means the account is open)
tables.transactions: Account operations: a positive amount is a deposit, a negative one is a withdrawal

ecommerce.description: An online store: customers, products, categories, orders, order items and reviews.

tables.order_items: Order items: product, quantity and price at the time of purchase

employees.description: A company HR database: departments, employees with a reporting hierarchy, projects, project assignments and salary history.

tables.projects: Department projects (end_date = NULL means the project is ongoing)
tables.employee_projects: Employee project assignments and hours worked

movies.description: A movie database: films, genres, directors, actors, roles and audience reviews.

tables.movies: Movies: budget and box office in millions of dollars (box_office_musd = NULL means no data)
tables.movie_cast: Actor roles in movies (billing_order is the order in the credits)

sales.description: Sales analytics of a B2B company for the first half of 2024: regions, sales reps, products, deals and monthly targets.

tables.products: Products: unit cost and unit price
tables.monthly_targets: Monthly sales targets per rep (month in YYYY-MM format)

university.description: A university: faculties, professors, courses with prerequisites, students and their grades.

tables.prerequisites: Prerequisites: which course must be completed before another one
tables.students: Students (faculty_id = NULL means no major chosen yet)
tables.enrollments: Course enrollments and grades 0–100 (NULL means the course is still in progress)
